models_evaluated: task-specific deep neural network trained from scratch

links.outcome: Recall when model defers uncertain reports to human review
links.effect: Retaining 72.9% of reports (deferring the rest to humans) increased recall from 0.894 to 0.969.
links.quote: We found that retaining 72.9% of reports increased recall from 0.894 to 0.969.

links.outcome: Recall of task-specific deep learning model versus general-purpose LLM on the same data
links.effect: Task-specific model recall 0.894 versus 0.824 for the general LLM.
links.quote: Our deep learning architecture trained on task-specific data outperforms a general-purpose LLM, with a recall of 0.894 compared to 0.824.

unlisted_practices: Uncertainty quantification with abstention to defer reports to human review
Task-specific small model trained from scratch instead of general-purpose LLM

screen.practice: uncertainty quantification and abstention for human review
screen.reason: The study evaluates an abstention mechanism using uncertainty quantification to defer uncertain cases to human review, directly measuring how this safeguard/deployment practice improves system-level recall.
